obligations.criterion: A controlled useful A-then-B versus B-then-A distinction reaches fresh search/dossier consumer; adaptive choices differ only after observable histories diverge. Relevant delay/no-op/stop comparators preserve residual commitments.
obligations.negative: Future/latent leakage, backdated late observation, noisy signposts, truncated tail loss, absent incumbent scope or planned capacity cannot silently support feasible adaptive recommendation.
obligations.removal: Remove history/transition/cutoff or incumbent consumption while preserving adaptive labels; the independent path/feasibility oracle and fresh consumer detect property loss.
obligations.scope: native mechanism required; genuine external claims separately qualified

obligations.criterion: An independently specified observationally equivalent model pair yields a feasible distinguishing design; a controlled owner-produced returned result reaches fresh claim consumer and changes only justified scope. A decision-equivalent alternative avoids unnecessary study; no operative world/posterior mutation without actual authorization.
obligations.negative: Uninformative repeated query, single-graph fallback intervention list, off-target receipt, adaptive unadjusted looks, mismatched target, fabricated permission or missing null outcomes cannot establish discriminating evidence. Current valid authorization for a different protocol/site, revoke before dispatch, or omitted decision-bearing basis filled by designer defaults cannot support the affected protected action or grounded numeric claim; explicit hypothetical scenarios remain candidates. Generic authorization falsifier: keep the grant valid and descriptive markers intact but change any native required operation facet (including recipient, population or intervention) outside its coverage, or add a new required facet. Actual owner coverage must fail; lawful bounded use of already-returned evidence is evaluated separately, not automatically erased.
obligations.removal: Remove actual discrimination or design-analysis-result/bridge binding while keeping study fields; oracle/consumer fails. Removing EVSI does not block a justified bounded acquisition route.
